title: Eupalinolide I derivative EJM alleviates experimental hyperuricemia through STAT1-associated regulation of intestinal inflammation and gut microbiota.
authors: Yan, Lilin; Zhu, Zhimin; Xu, Yuanjian; Lin, Yudong; Xu, Zhaohui; Zhou, Mingmei
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究EJM通过STAT1调控肠道炎症和尿酸转运缓解高尿酸血症，虽涉及分子对接但核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hyperuricemia (HUA) is increasingly recognized as a systemic disorder involving metabolic dysregulation and chronic inflammation, with emerging evidence implicating the intestine as a key extra-renal site of urate handling. However, the molecular mechanisms linking intestinal inflammation, urate transport, and immune signaling in HUA remain incompletely understood. AIM: This study aimed to evaluate the anti-hyperuricemic effects of EJM, a synthetic derivative of eupalinolide I, and to explore its potential mechanisms with a particular focus on intestinal inflammation, urate transport, and immune-related signaling pathways. METHODS: HUA was induced in mice using potassium oxonate, yeast extract, and fructose. The effects of EJM were assessed via serum biochemistry, histopathology, Western blotting, and 16S rRNA sequencing. The direct target of EJM was identified using human proteome microarray and validated by cellular thermal shift assay and molecular docking. RESULTS: EJM significantly reduced serum uric acid levels and alleviated renal and intestinal pathological injury in hyperuricemic mice. Proteome microarray screening, molecular docking, and cellular thermal shift assay supported STAT1 as a binding target of EJM. EJM treatment was associated with attenuation of intestinal IFN-gamma/JAK/STAT1 pathway activation and reduced levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including IFN-gamma, IL-17A, IL-6, and TNF-alpha. These changes were accompanied by coordinated regulation of urate transporters: EJM downregulated renal URAT1 and GLUT9, reduced intestinal GLUT9, and upregulated ABCG2 in both kidney and intestine, thereby favoring urate excretion. In addition, EJM treatment partially reversed HUA-associated gut microbiota dysbiosis, with changes in microbial taxa related to intestinal inflammation and urate metabolism. CONCLUSION: EJM exhibits anti-hyperuricemic activity in experimental HUA. The findings suggest that STAT1-associated intestinal inflammatory regulation and urate transport modulation may contribute to its pharmacological effects, with gut microbiota changes occurring in parallel. Further functional validation is required to establish the causal roles of STAT1 signaling and microbiota remodeling.
abstract_zh: 背景：高尿酸血症（HUA）日益被视为一种涉及代谢紊乱和慢性炎症的系统性疾病，新近证据提示肠道是尿酸处理的肾外关键部位。然而，连接肠道炎症、尿酸转运和免疫信号传导在HUA中的分子机制仍不完全清楚。目的：本研究旨在评估EJM（eupalinolide I的合成衍生物）的抗高尿酸血症作用，并探讨其潜在机制，特别关注肠道炎症、尿酸转运和免疫相关信号通路。方法：使用氧嗪酸钾、酵母提取物和果糖诱导小鼠HUA。通过血清生化、组织病理学、Western blotting和16S rRNA测序评估EJM的作用。利用人类蛋白质组微阵列鉴定EJM的直接靶点，并通过细胞热位移分析和分子对接进行验证。结果：EJM显著降低高尿酸血症小鼠的血清尿酸水平，并减轻肾脏和肠道病理损伤。蛋白质组微阵列筛选、分子对接和细胞热位移分析支持STAT1为EJM的结合靶点。EJM治疗与肠道IFN-gamma/JAK/STAT1通路激活的减弱以及促炎细胞因子（包括IFN-gamma、IL-17A、IL-6和TNF-alpha）水平的降低相关。这些变化伴随尿酸转运体的协调调控：EJM下调肾脏URAT1和GLUT9，减少肠道GLUT9，并在肾脏和肠道中上调ABCG2，从而促进尿酸排泄。此外，EJM治疗部分逆转了HUA相关的肠道菌群失调，与肠道炎症和尿酸代谢相关的微生物类群发生变化。结论：EJM在实验性HUA中表现出抗高尿酸血症活性。研究结果表明，STAT1相关的肠道炎症调节和尿酸转运调控可能有助于其药理作用，肠道菌群变化并行发生。需要进一步的功能验证以确立STAT1信号传导和菌群重塑的因果作用。
